summary: Submitted two interpretations for the replay-completion question in order. First a source-only correction account (no experiment id, conclusion explained, no defect judgment) that answers the three gaps opened by the knowledge correction: the delivered batch count is ceil(commit tuples / MaxAppendEntries), since prepareLog produces tuples only for commands, barriers and (above protocol version 2) configuration entries, so any count derived from a log index range is an upper bound; the boundary receipt 8a710c75d1814aafad5d24b536998539 is cited as non-supporting corroboration (2048 tuples/128 batches returning in 0ms versus 2049 tuples/129 batches not returning, while the entry-based figure reads 129 in the returning case), and all three gaps are marked resolved. Second the experiment-cited defect account (conclusion violated, defect asserted, four receipts) so the question's current account keeps its defect judgment and boundary-pinned bound. Effects: two interpretation appends. No new probe was submitted this turn; the remaining unmeasured item is how readily a default snapshot cadence crosses the bound.
